# 周末不无聊 No Boring Weekends

> 北美华人周末活动指南：15 个城市的亲子和大人周末活动，华人与亚裔社区活动优先，中英双语，每周更新（本期 11/6–11/8，更新于 2026-11-04）。
> Weekend events for families and grown-ups in 15 North American cities (festivals, shows, family outings, Chinese/Asian community events), bilingual, updated weekly.

每个城市有固定网址的「本周末」页面，内容每周替换；每个城市还有可订阅的日历（.ics）。活动信息以主办方官网为准。
Each city has a fixed weekend page that is replaced weekly, plus a subscribable .ics calendar. Check organizers' sites before going.

## 城市页（中文）
- [纽约本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nyc/): 5 个活动，亚洲协会排灯节亲子日、法拉盛 BAPS 排灯节 + 烟花、布鲁克林儿童博物馆:亡灵节 + 排灯节
- [新泽西本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nj/): 9 个活动，上海芭蕾舞团新泽西演出、老桥图书馆排灯节手工、泽西市 Diwali Together
- [洛杉矶本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/la/): 5 个活动，洛杉矶 Diwali Fest、奇诺岗 BAPS 神庙排灯节、Self Help Graphics 亡灵节
- [旧金山湾区本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sf/): 4 个活动，美国台湾博览会(湾区)、要塞公园亡灵节 + 排灯节、山口·克里斯蒂冰场开幕
- [西雅图本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sea/): 7 个活动，贝尔维尤购物中心排灯节、西雅图中心「印度之光」排灯节、伊萨夸孟加拉排灯节
- [波士顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/bos/): 5 个活动，哈佛广场泰国夜市、哈蒙德城堡文艺复兴日、牙买加平原砸南瓜
- [芝加哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/chi/): 5 个活动，Kalapriya 排灯节、内珀维尔 ISKCON 排灯节、芝加哥河畔 ART on THE MART 灯光秀
- [休斯顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/hou/): 7 个活动，亚洲协会德州中心夜市、ISKCON 休斯顿排灯节烛光祈福、Petco 大型宠物领养会
- [达拉斯本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dal/): 7 个活动，沃斯堡日本花园秋祭、大学园图书馆排灯节故事会、Panda Fest 亚洲美食节
- [华盛顿 DC本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dc/): 6 个活动，国立亚洲艺术博物馆排灯节夜场、DC 市长亚太事务办排灯节、费尔法克斯泡菜节
- [橙县 / 尔湾本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/oc/): 6 个活动，尔湾大公园节日手作市集、塔斯廷退伍军人节庆典 + 车展、OC 儿童博览会
- [圣地亚哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sd/): 6 个活动，米拉梅萨 Shri Mandir 排灯节集市、第 27 届圣地亚哥亚洲电影节、ISKCON 圣地亚哥供品山节
- [亚特兰大本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/atl/): 6 个活动，约翰斯溪排灯节、邓伍迪自然中心排灯节、Chai Pani 迪凯特排灯节
- [多伦多本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/tor/): 5 个活动，列治文山 Vishnu Mandir 排灯节晚会、印度街 Gerrard 排灯节、越南博览会 Viet Expo
- [温哥华本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/van/): 6 个活动，素里 RED FM 排灯节、Roundhouse 社区中心排灯节、第 30 届温哥华亚洲电影节

## City pages (English)
- [New York weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nyc/): 5 events, e.g. Día de los Muertos & Diwali at Brooklyn Children's Museum; Family Art Project: Raptors in Autumn Sky; Diwali Lights at Asia Society
- [New Jersey weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nj/): 9 events, e.g. Shanghai Ballet at State Theatre New Jersey; Mineral, Gem & Jewelry Show at Trailside; Diwali Celebration at Old Bridge Library
- [Los Angeles weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/la/): 5 events, e.g. Self Help Graphics Día de los Muertos; Los Angeles Diwali Fest; Kidspace Winter Frolic
- [SF Bay Area weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sf/): 4 events, e.g. Kristi Yamaguchi Holiday Ice Rink Opening; SF Coffee Festival; USA Taiwan Global Expo, Bay Area
- [Seattle weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sea/): 7 events, e.g. Sea-Meow Cat Expo; Short Run Comix Festival; Diwali at The Bellevue Collection
- [Boston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/bos/): 5 events, e.g. Renaissance Faire Day at Hammond Castle; Pumpkin Smash, Jamaica Plain; Boston Veterans Day Parade
- [Chicago weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/chi/): 5 events, e.g. Kalapriya Diwali; ART on THE MART; Christmas Around the World at MSI
- [Houston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/hou/): 7 events, e.g. Asia Society Texas Night Market; Petco Love Jump Into Joy Adoption Event; Depot Day Fall Fest, Tomball
- [Dallas weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dal/): 7 events, e.g. Japanese Fall Festival, Fort Worth Botanic Garden; Diwali Story Time with Shachi Kaushik; Festival at the Switchyard, Carrollton
- [Washington DC weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dc/): 6 events, e.g. Asia After Dark: Diwali at the National Museum of Asian Art; MOAPIA Diwali Celebration; Czech Christmas Market at the Embassy
- [Orange County weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/oc/): 6 events, e.g. 44th Annual Holiday Faire, Great Park; Tustin Veterans Day Celebration & Car Show; OC Kids Expo
- [San Diego weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sd/): 6 events, e.g. City Heights Fall Carnival; Shri Mandir Diwali Mela; 27th San Diego Asian Film Festival
- [Atlanta weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/atl/): 6 events, e.g. Norcross International Night Market; Chomp & Stomp; Johns Creek Diwali Celebration
- [Toronto weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/tor/): 5 events, e.g. Diwali Milan at Vishnu Mandir; Diwali Mela at Gerrard India Bazaar; Royal Agricultural Winter Fair
- [Vancouver weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/van/): 6 events, e.g. Riley Park Winter Farmers Market; RED FM Diwali Dhamaka; Diwali Fest at Roundhouse Community Centre
